read-prerequisites.title: [Checklist] Review CNCF sandbox prerequisites
read-prerequisites.body:
Review the CNCF sandbox prerequisites in the `read_prerequisites` section of [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md) (links and policy notes are there).

When complete, add your review notes under **Your answer** in that section and open a PR with `Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER`.

project-summary.title: [Application] Project summary and description
project-summary.body:
Draft the one-line project summary and 100–300 word project description for the sandbox application.

Update the `project_summary` and `project_description` fields in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

When complete, open a PR and include `Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER` in the PR description.

reusable-project.title: [Critical] Confirm project is reusable (not a reference architecture)
reusable-project.body:
Confirm this is a reusable open source project designed for broad adoption—not a reference architecture, reference implementation, or company-specific platform.

Check the box in the `not_reference_architecture` field in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md). If this is a reference architecture, apply to [CNCF Reference Architectures](https://architecture.cncf.io/) instead.

When complete, open a PR and include `Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER` in the PR description.

org-and-repo-urls.title: [Application] Org and repository URLs
org-and-repo-urls.body:
Document org repo URL, primary project repo URL, and any additional repos in scope.

Update `org_repo_url`, `project_repo_url`, and `additional_repos` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

parent-separation-vote.title: [Critical] Parent project separation vote (if applicable)
parent-separation-vote.body:
If the project is separating from a parent organization, link to a public issue in the parent project showing maintainer consensus to split.

If not applicable, document "N/A" in the `parent_separation_vote` field in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

website-url.title: [Application] Website URL
website-url.body:
Provide the project website URL (or primary repo URL if no website).

Update `website_url` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

roadmap.title: [Application] Roadmap and roadmap context
roadmap.body:
Provide a publicly accessible roadmap URL and optional context.

Update `roadmap` and `roadmap_context` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

contributing-guide.title: [Application] Contributing guide
contributing-guide.body:
Provide a direct link to the project's contributing guide.

Update `contributing_guide` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

code-of-conduct.title: [Application] Code of Conduct
code-of-conduct.body:
Provide a direct link to the project's Code of Conduct.

Update `code_of_conduct` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

adopters.title: [Application] Adopters list
adopters.body:
Provide a link to the project's adopters file or document why one does not exist yet.

Update `adopters` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

maintainers-file.title: [Critical] MAINTAINERS file with required columns
maintainers-file.body:
Create or verify `MAINTAINERS.md` with Name, GitHub ID, and Company/Organization columns. Provide a direct GitHub `/blob/` link—not a contributors graph.

Example format:
```markdown
| Maintainer | GitHub ID | Company/Organization |
| ---------- | --------- | -------------------- |
| Jane Doe   | @janedoe  | Acme Corp            |
```

Document the link in the `maintainers_file` field in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

security-policy.title: [Application] Security policy (SECURITY.md)
security-policy.body:
Provide a direct link to the project's security policy. See [security guidelines](https://contribute.cncf.io/maintainers/security/security-guidelines/#3-securitymd) and [templates](https://github.com/cncf/tag-security/tree/main/community/resources/project-resources/templates).

Update `security_policy` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

standard-or-spec.title: [Application] Standard or specification details
standard-or-spec.body:
Document whether the project is or includes a standard or specification. Write "N/A" if not applicable.

Update `standard_or_spec` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

product-separation.title: [Application] Business product/service separation
product-separation.body:
Explain how the project is separated from any related commercial products or services.

Update `product_separation` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

why-cncf.title: [Application] Why CNCF?
why-cncf.body:
Draft why the project wants to join CNCF and what value CNCF membership provides.

Update `why_cncf` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

landscape-benefit.title: [Application] Benefit to the Cloud Native Landscape
landscape-benefit.body:
Describe how the project benefits the landscape and its differentiator.

Update `landscape_benefit` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

cloud-native-fit.title: [Application] Cloud native fit
cloud-native-fit.body:
Explain where the project fits in the cloud native landscape.

Update `cloud_native_fit` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

cloud-native-integration.title: [Application] Cloud native integration
cloud-native-integration.body:
Document which CNCF projects this complements or depends on.

Update `cloud_native_integration` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

cloud-native-overlap.title: [Application] Cloud native overlap
cloud-native-overlap.body:
Document overlapping CNCF projects and how you differentiate.

Update `cloud_native_overlap` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

similar-projects.title: [Application] Similar projects
similar-projects.body:
List similar projects in CNCF or elsewhere (or "N/A").

Update `similar_projects` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

landscape-listing.title: [Application] Cloud Native Landscape listing
landscape-listing.body:
Document whether the project is listed on [landscape.cncf.io](https://landscape.cncf.io/).

Update `landscape` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

lfx-insights.title: [Application] LFX Insights listing
lfx-insights.body:
Document whether the project is listed on [LFX Insights](https://insights.linuxfoundation.org/).

Update `insights` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

trademark-agreement.title: [Application] Trademark and accounts agreement
trademark-agreement.body:
Confirm agreement to donate project trademarks and accounts to CNCF if accepted.

Check the box in `trademark_agreement` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

ip-policy-agreement.title: [Application] CNCF IP policy agreement
ip-policy-agreement.body:
Confirm agreement to follow the CNCF IP Policy if accepted.

Check the box in `ip_policy_agreement` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

apache-2-license.title: [Critical] Apache 2.0 license compliance
apache-2-license.body:
Verify the project uses Apache 2.0 (or document required license exception). License must be compliant **before** acceptance.

Document evidence in the `license` field in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md) and link to the LICENSE file in the project repo.

license-exception.title: [Application] License exception review
license-exception.body:
Document whether a license exception is needed. Write "N/A" if using Apache 2.0.

Update `license_exception` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

dependency-licenses.title: [Application] Dependency license compliance
dependency-licenses.body:
Verify all dependencies use allowlisted licenses or approved exceptions.

Update `dependency_licenses` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

domain-technical-review.title: [Application] Domain Technical Review (optional)
domain-technical-review.body:
Link any TAG engagement, presentations, or completed General Technical Review questionnaire.

Update `domain_technical_review` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

repo-age-and-activity.title: [Critical] Repository age and active development
repo-age-and-activity.body:
Verify the repository is at least 6 months old with active development. Document evidence (creation date, recent commits, releases).

Update `repo_age_evidence` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

maintainer-diversity.title: [Recommended] Maintainer organization diversity
maintainer-diversity.body:
Document maintainer employer diversity (different companies, not different GitHub orgs).

Update `maintainer_diversity` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

contact-information.title: [Application] Contact and signatory information
contact-information.body:
Add application contact emails and Contribution Agreement signatory information.

Update `application_contact_emails` and `signatory_information` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

**Do not commit private emails in public repos** if this application repo is public—use a private fork or store contacts in a secure location and fill them in only when generating the submission.

additional-information.title: [Application] Additional information and CNCF contacts
additional-information.body:
Add CNCF contacts and any additional context for the TOC.

Update `cncf_contacts` and `additional_information` in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md).

final-review.title: [Submit] Final application review and CNCF submission
final-review.body:
Follow the `final_review` section in [APPLICATION.md](../APPLICATION.md), then generate and submit:

```bash
./scripts/generate-submission.sh --validate
./scripts/generate-submission.sh --create-issue --project-name "YourProject"
```

`--create-issue` records the CNCF issue link in APPLICATION.md and README. Open a PR with `Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER` when the final-review item is done.
